mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews ( reservation_id, rating, content, created_at ) VALUES ( #{reservationId}, #{rating}, #{content}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS id, r.reservation_id AS reservationId, res.guest_user_id AS memberId, res.place_id AS placeId, p.name AS placeName, r.content AS content, r.rating AS rating, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM reviews r JOIN reservations res ON r.reservation_id = res.id JOIN places p ON res.place_id = p.id WHERE res.guest_user_id = #{memberId} AND r.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
